title: 第525章 女帝问名第524章 各退一步
content_zh:
第525章女帝问名
周尘闻言，心中猛地一凛。
他能感觉到，女帝的目光落在他身上时，仿佛有一道无形的压力，将他整个人都笼罩在其中。
他连忙低下头，不敢与女帝对视，恭恭敬敬地拱手行礼道：
“草民周尘，见过陛下。”
他表面上风轻云淡，但心中却早已掀起了惊涛骇浪。
女帝怎么会突然注意到自己？
难道是因为姜瑾瑜？
还是说，她发现了什么？
周尘的心中飞速转动着各种念头，但面上却不敢露出丝毫破绽。
女帝姜璇玑看着眼前这个少年，目光中闪过一丝若有所思的神色。
“朕想起来了。”
她缓缓说道，声音中带着一丝意味深长：
“瑾瑜以前跟朕提起过，说在天丹门的地火大典上，遇到过一个有意思的人。”
“那人似乎颇为特别，倒是让她难得的提起过几次。”
“那人，便是你吧？”
周尘心中一凛。
瑾瑜，那应该就是大乾公主姜瑾瑜了。
他确实和姜瑾瑜有过约定，当初天丹门地火大典结束之后，他答应过姜瑾瑜，要帮她炼制一枚能破除体质封印的丹药，彻底觉醒九阴归元体。
他记得当初羲和女帝说过，姜瑾瑜体内的封印极为高明，绝非一般手段所能设下。

能对她这位公主殿下出手的人，实力必定极强。
能够在不伤及她体质的前提下，将她的九阴归元体封禁大半，并且让她和满朝文武都浑然不觉。
这种手段，整个大乾境内，恐怕也只有一个人能做到。
那个人，就是她的母亲，眼前这位大乾女帝。
当然，周尘不知道，这位大乾女帝为什么要封印自家女儿的九阴归元体。
女帝既然亲手掌管这封印，那她必然有自己的考量和打算。
以她涅槃境的修为，统御十三州的多年经验，不可能看不出自己女儿身上的问题。
她明知姜瑾瑜体质有恙，却迟迟不肯出手解开，反而设置禁制将其封住，必然有其深意。
不过自己和姜瑾瑜的事情，显然不能当着女帝的面说出来。
周尘凝神凝气，平静回答道：
“陛下慧眼，正是在下。”
“当时在天丹门，草民与公主殿下偶然相遇，相谈几句，便就此别过。”
“承蒙公主殿下不弃，说日后若有机会，可以到王都一叙。”
女帝姜璇玑微微颔首，继续道：
“瑾瑜那丫头，回来后经常提起你。”
“她说，你很有意思，还说你答应了她，会去王都找她？”
周尘拱手道：“回陛下，草民确实与公主殿下有过约定，待草民修为有成，便去王都拜访公主殿下。”
女帝姜璇玑听完周尘的话，沉默了片刻，淡淡道：
content_en:
Chapter 525 The Empress Asks for Name
When Zhou Chen heard this, his heart suddenly trembled.
He could feel that when the empress' eyes fell on him, there seemed to be an invisible pressure that enveloped his whole body.
He quickly lowered his head, not daring to look at the empress, and bowed his hands respectfully:
"Caomin Zhou Chen has met Your Majesty."
He looked calm and calm on the surface, but there was already a storm in his heart.
Why did the empress suddenly notice herself?
Is it because of Jiang Jinyu?
Or, what did she discover?
Zhou Chen's mind was racing with various thoughts, but he did not dare to show any flaws on his face.
Empress Jiang Xuanji looked at the young man in front of her with a thoughtful look in her eyes.
"I remembered."
She said slowly, with a hint of meaning in her voice:
"Jin Yu mentioned to me before that she met an interesting person at the Earth Fire Ceremony of Tiandan Sect."
"That person seems to be quite special, but she rarely mentions him a few times."
"That person is you, right?"
Zhou Chen's heart trembled.
Jinyu, that should be Jiang Jinyu, Princess of Daqian.
He did have an agreement with Jiang Jinyu. After the Tiandanmen Earth Fire Ceremony, he promised Jiang Jinyu that he would help her refine a pill that could break the seal of her constitution and completely awaken the Nine Yin Guiyuan Ti.
He remembered that Xihe and the Empress had said that the seal in Jiang Jinyu's body was extremely clever and could not be set by ordinary means.
Anyone who can take action against Her Royal Highness, the Princess, must be extremely powerful.
It was able to seal most of her Jiuyin Guiyuan Body without damaging her physique, and made her and the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty unaware of it.
There is probably only one person in the entire Daqian territory who can do this method.
That person is her mother, the Empress of Daqian in front of her.
Of course, Zhou Chen didn't know why the Empress of Daqian sealed her daughter's Nine Yin Gui Yuan Ti.
Since the empress personally controls this seal, she must have her own considerations and plans.
With her Nirvana realm cultivation and many years of experience in governing the Thirteen States, it was impossible for her not to see the problem with her daughter.
She knew that Jiang Jinyu was physically ill, but she still refused to untie him. Instead, she set up a restriction to seal it, which must have a deep meaning.
However, it was obvious that he and Jiang Jinyu could not be told in front of the empress.
Zhou Chen concentrated his energy and replied calmly:
"Your Majesty's discerning eye is mine."
"At that time, at Tiandan Gate, the common people and Her Royal Highness the Princess met by chance. They talked for a few words and then parted ways."
"Thanks to Her Majesty the Princess for not giving up, she said that if there is an opportunity in the future, she can go to the royal capital to talk about it."
Empress Jiang Xuanji nodded slightly and continued:
"That girl Jinyu, she often talks about you after she comes back."
"She said you were very interesting. She also said you promised her that you would go to the capital to find her?"
Zhou Chen cupped his hands and said, "Back to Your Majesty, Cao Min has indeed made an agreement with Her Highness the Princess. When Cao Min succeeds in his cultivation, he will go to the royal capital to visit Her Highness the Princess."
After listening to Zhou Chen's words, Empress Jiang Xuanji was silent for a moment and said lightly:
